note: fetched (PDF text extracted 2026-07-28). Original figure 736300 long tons, converted to metric tonnes; 'Production of copper ore (metal content)' table. Values for 1966-1969 cross-checked against the 1966-1970 volume (nora.nerc.ac.uk/id/eprint/535264), whose 1970 value (673,300 long tons = 684,100 t) matches the modern BGS database exactly. Caveat: USGS Minerals Yearbook reports 1969 mine output as 719,467 t (basis difference); BGS series used for consistency.
